body.name: \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{CPCM}}\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{CPCM}}=\{((P_r,d_r))_{r=1}^{K}:\text{ for every }r,\ P_r\in\mathcal P(\mathbb N_0^p)\text{ is generated by a causally minimal count-valued CPCM with labeled DAG }d_r\text{ in the sense of Definition 9 of Bodik--Chavez-Demoulin, and assumption }\mathrm{ass{:}pairwise\text{-}identifiability}\text{ holds in the sense of their Definition 10}\}\). No parametric restriction is imposed on a source-node law beyond being a probability law on \(\mathbb N_0\).
